research_question: Does a learned hierarchical stem-affix representation reconstruct actual unfamiliar words from partial word+side context better per cost than independent lexical, flat suffix, character ngram and trained recurrent character models?

arms.CLOSED_PREFIX: Fit full TRAIN target word frequency; choose prefix match (favor context word associations with fixed training-only weight 0.2), or output raw three-letter prefix as abstention
arms.FLAT_SUFFIX: Fit suffix frequencies length1..5 conditioned observed first-three-character prefix, else global suffix; no stem abstraction; same gold words
arms.CHAR_TRIGRAM_BEAM: Original L5 learned trigram architecture byte-identical Git blob REQUIRED, with fixed beam12, max word18, length penalty .04, smoothing .5; copy directly from L5 source and expose learned character trigram arm (only 900 TRAIN)
arms.HIERARCHICAL_STEM_AFFIX: Discover TRAIN suffix morphemes of length1..5 by frequency, limit to top32 with count>=3; parse each training word into one stem length>=3 and one suffix in frozen library maximizing (suffix_count+0.5)/(number_of_train_words+0.5*32) weighted by known-stem support; estimate prefix-conditioned stem distributions and stem-conditioned suffix distributions with add0.5; inference generate candidate stems consistent with visible first3, rank stem+suffix and context learned from TRAIN. No oracle morphology or hand-coded English affixes. Limit 40 stems per prefix and top16 suffixes per stem, no beam/DEV tuning. Unknown-word generation permitted.
arms.HIERARCHICAL_NO_AFFIX_ABLATION: Same fitted discovered stem inventory and context but allow only unchanged full memorized TRAIN target words; tests contribution of recombination.
arms.RNN_CHAR_H20: Train 20-hidden unit true tanh recurrent character language predictor with full BPTT on exact same TRAIN target words; seeds17/31, 8 epochs, batch32, LR.025, Adam(.9,.999,1e-8), gradient clip 2, choose start solely SELECT mean next-char NLL. At inference provided prefix only; beam4, max word18, never gold, no external pretrained resources.

controls: Equal supervised TRAIN words, visibility of prefix and left/right, but learning algorithms/parameters/compute budgets differ. No matched trained transformer/state-space neural language model, no general Pareto GO.
